scope: Convert an already-bound parameter-family proposal and historical local eligibility carrier into a bounded, rejectable compare-and-swap candidate delta without writing graph state.

bootstrap_formula.candidate: family proposal times historical local eligibility times configured neutral step scale

persisted: per-family proposal flag and role-neutral reason code
expected current parameter value as compare-and-swap and rollback guard

cumulative_budget.reason: audit-only proposals must not fabricate applied plasticity or block later proposals

compatibility.v0115_checkpoint: upgrade allocates empty update-safety metadata without fabricating deltas
compatibility.birth: newborn event ring starts with no update proposals
compatibility.clone_checkpoint_compaction: committed bounded proposal metadata is copied exactly
compatibility.death: proposal metadata is cleared with the row

forbidden: writing any graph parameter in Stage 3C-2
treating objective state changes as engine-defined positive or negative value
using association similarity or delay as update magnitude
allowing stale node or edge identity to receive a proposal
counting audit-only proposals as applied long-window plasticity
claiming candidate deltas as learning, adaptation or subjecthood
